title.narrative: Mount Hoyo Peace and Reconciliation Project 2021

description.narrative: Hope in Action DR Congo (HiA) will during a six-month period implement activities aiming to contribute towards peace, stabilization and reconciliation in the area around Mount Hoyo nature reserve in the Democratic Republic of Congo, an area highly affected by insurgency. The expected effects for the target group of the Project are (Outcome) to contribute to a sense of normality, economic empowerment, and active participation for people in the area.The planned main products and/or services of the Project are the following outputs: Distribution of 300 farming kits; 2) Rehabilitation of 13 km of access road in the Mount Hoyo forest reserve; 3) 2 overnight gatherings with local leaders; 4) 4 football tournaments and 5) 2 drama seminars.The intended target group is 300 families directly affected by the insurgency in the area, 170 young men and women at risk of being recruited by, or already recruited by rebel groups, local chiefs, leaders of women’s groups, local church leaders and leaders of local NGOs, local youth and villagers (also as spectators and players). The Security Council's resolution on women, peace and security (1325) constitutes an integral part of the project activities.
